$comment: Hand-written expected values for fixtures/specs/qa/unsatisfiable-schemas.yaml (criterion 7) other than the synthesis-failed list itself, which is in expected/synthesis-failed.json with a reason per case. 'sampleValues' are expectations on the SampleValue of each control's operation (ADR 0003 'The portal bundle', SampleValue): origin 'synthesized' and the keywords named in 'uncheckedIncludes' reported as not checked. 'looksLike' is a check of ours on the synthesized value.

sampleValues.name: x
sampleValues.rule: 0.5 satisfies exclusiveMinimum 0 and exclusiveMaximum 1 for a number; synthesis-failed here would be a synthesizer fault

sampleValues.name: p
sampleValues.rule: ADR 0003 'Schema validation': pattern is never executed and is reported as unchecked, never as satisfied or violated, so no synthesis-failed although '^$' and minLength 1 together admit nothing (m1.md 'Not tested by these criteria', a sample value against a pattern)

sampleValues.name: f
sampleValues.rule: ADR 0003: a format outside the nine checked is unchecked and its synthesized value is a plain string

sampleValues.name: e
sampleValues.rule: Criterion 7: an email-format string looks like an email, not "string"; email is one of the nine checked formats

includes.rule: ADR 0003 'allOf merging': the members of caseAllOfTypes give different types. Pointer not asserted (question QA-3)

findings.exactCodesRule: synthesis-failed is asserted exactly from expected/synthesis-failed.json, for this and every committed fixture.
